summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.75/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.75 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 4, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 5¢ lower than a week ago, 13¢ lower than a month ago, and 83¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.55) and the highest in Superior ($4.05).
